description: Show one event's closing line: each bookmaker's opening and closing price per outcome, the fair closing price (margin removed, usually from Pinnacle's closing market) and each opening price's closing line value (CLV). Give outcome_id and odds to get the CLV of your own bet. Closing prices exist once the event has started. Needs Pro or the free Pro trial; 10 credits a call.

bookmakers.description: Optional comma separated bookmaker keys, at most 20, instead of region

event_id.description: Event ID from find_event, for example ev_000ckk0nc1tg

market.description: h2h, h2h_3way, line or total. Leave it out for the main markets.

odds.description: The decimal odds you took, with outcome_id

outcome_id.description: The outcome (oc_...) you bet on, with odds, to get your bet's closing line value

region.description: Show prices from bookmakers in this region. Default au. Use all for every bookmaker.

name: closing_line
title: Closing line and CLV
